findings.issue: The product document does not mention that Satpura Finance, as the RE, must put in place a Board-approved policy before entering into any DLG arrangement. This policy must include eligibility criteria for the DLG provider, nature and extent of DLG cover, process of monitoring and reviewing the DLG arrangement, and details of fees, if any, payable to or received by the DLG provider.
findings.doc_evidence: QuickLine Tech provides a DLG of 5% of the disbursed portfolio as cash deposited with Satpura Finance, under a Board-approved DLG policy.

findings.issue: The product document does not mention that Satpura Finance must ensure that any DLG arrangement does not act as a substitute for credit appraisal requirements and robust credit underwriting standards.
findings.doc_evidence: QuickLine Tech provides a DLG of 5% of the disbursed portfolio as cash deposited with Satpura Finance, under a Board-approved DLG policy.

findings.issue: The product document does not mention that RE shall ensure that any collection of data by their DLA and DLA of their LSP is need-based and with prior and explicit consent of the borrower having audit trail. It also does not mention that DLA of RE/LSP must desist from accessing mobile phone resources like file and media, contact list, call logs, telephony functions, etc.
findings.doc_evidence: The app collects only name, phone and PAN; age, occupation and income are not asked.

findings.issue: The product document does not mention that the borrower shall be provided with an option to give or deny consent for use of specific data, restrict disclosure to third parties, data retention, revoke consent already granted to collect personal data, and if required, make the RE/LSP delete/forget the data.
findings.doc_evidence: The app collects only name, phone and PAN; age, occupation and income are not asked.

findings.issue: The product document does not mention that the total amount of DLG cover on any outstanding portfolio which is specified upfront shall not exceed five per cent of the total amount disbursed out of that loan portfolio at any given time. It also does not mention that in case of implicit guarantee arrangements, the DLG Provider shall not bear performance risk of more than the equivalent amount of five per cent of the underlying loan portfolio.
findings.doc_evidence: QuickLine Tech provides a DLG of 5% of the disbursed portfolio as cash deposited with Satpura Finance, under a Board-approved DLG policy.

findings.issue: The product document does not mention that the portfolio over which DLG can be offered shall consist of identifiable and measurable loan assets which have been sanctioned (the 'DLG set'). This portfolio shall remain fixed for the purpose of DLG cover and is not meant to be dynamic.
findings.doc_evidence: QuickLine Tech provides a DLG of 5% of the disbursed portfolio as cash deposited with Satpura Finance, under a Board-approved DLG policy.

findings.issue: The product document does not mention that RE shall disclose upfront in KFS that a reasonable one-time processing fee may be retained if the customer exits the loan during the cooling-off period.
findings.doc_evidence: Borrowers can exit within 2 days by repaying the principal and proportionate APR without penalty.

findings.issue: The product document does not mention that RE shall not enter into DLG arrangements for revolving credit facilities offered through digital lending channel and credit cards as defined under Master Direction – Credit Card and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022 dated April 21, 2022.
findings.doc_evidence: QuickLine Tech provides a DLG of 5% of the disbursed portfolio as cash deposited with Satpura Finance, under a Board-approved DLG policy.

findings.issue: The product document does not mention that RE shall not enter into DLG arrangements for loans which are covered by the credit guarantee schemes administered by trust funds as specified under para 2 of Review of Prudential Norms – Risk Weights for Exposures guaranteed by Credit Guarantee Schemes (CGS) dated September 07, 2022, as amended from time to time.
findings.doc_evidence: QuickLine Tech provides a DLG of 5% of the disbursed portfolio as cash deposited with Satpura Finance, under a Board-approved DLG policy.

findings.issue: The product document does not mention that RE shall put in place a mechanism to ensure that LSPs with whom they have a DLG arrangement shall publish on their website the total number of portfolios and the respective amount of each portfolio on which DLG has been offered.
